T: Two Chicago cops. One more week.
D: Two Chicago cops planning to retire to Key West get pulled into one last case.
P: Serve the mains when they daydream about Key West.
S: the beat they walk every day
All-beef franks, poppy seed buns, mustard, relish, onion, tomato, pickle spear, sport peppers and celery salt.
Chopped prawn in a batter of flour, egg, milk, capsicum, onion and celery, fried in spoonfuls at 180C, lime mayo.
M: the bar they want to buy
Snapper strips grilled with lime and chilli, corn tortillas, cabbage, mango salsa and lime crema.
Topside roasted rare, shaved thin, warmed in garlic and oregano jus, piled into rolls, dipped, hot giardiniera.
W: the bar in Key West they dream about
Biscuit crust, filling of condensed milk, yolks and lime juice baked at 160C for 15 minutes, chilled, whipped cream.
K: 45ml rum, 30ml pineapple, 30ml orange, 15ml lime and a dash of grenadine over ice, grated nutmeg.

edition.tagline: Two Chicago cops. One more week.
edition.cue: Serve the mains when they daydream about Key West.

s.note: Beef franks with mustard, relish, onion, tomato, pickles and celery salt.
s.how: Heat 4 small all-beef franks in simmering water for 5 minutes until piping hot. Warm 4 small poppy seed hot dog buns in a steamer for 1 minute. Add the franks and divide 20g yellow mustard, 30g sweet relish, half a diced onion, 1 sliced tomato, 4 pickle spears and 8 sport peppers among the buns. Finish with 1/4 tsp celery salt. Serve one small hot dog each.
shop: 4 small poppy seed hot dog buns@Bakery

s.note: Crisp prawn fritters with lime mayo, Key West style.
s.how: Finely chop 300g peeled prawns. Mix 150g flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 egg and 125ml milk to a thick batter, then fold in the prawns, half a diced red capsicum, half a diced onion and 1 diced celery stick. Fry spoonfuls at 180C for 3 minutes until golden. Serve with 150g mayonnaise mixed with the juice of 1 lime.

m.note: Thin roast beef in garlic oregano jus, dipped rolls and hot giardiniera.
m.how: Season 800g beef topside with 1 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp black pepper. Roast at 200°C conventional for about 40 minutes, checking with a thermometer, until 52°C at the centre for rare. Rest 20 minutes. Simmer 400ml beef stock with 3 crushed garlic cloves and 1 tsp dried oregano for 10 minutes to make jus. Shave the rested beef very thin and warm gently in the jus for 1 minute. Pile into 4 long rolls, dip briefly in the jus and top with 100g hot giardiniera.

w.note: Biscuit crust with baked lime custard and chilled whipped cream.
w.how: Crush 150g digestive biscuits and mix with 60g melted butter. Press into a 20cm pie dish. Whisk 400g condensed milk, 4 egg yolks and 120ml lime juice until smooth, then pour into the crust. Bake at 160°C conventional for 15 minutes until just set. Cool and chill for at least 4 hours. Softly whip 100ml thickened cream, spoon over the pie and divide into four generous portions.

d.note: Rum, pineapple, orange and lime over ice with grenadine and nutmeg.
d.how: Fill four glasses with 400g ice. For each drink add 45ml golden rum, 30ml pineapple juice, 30ml orange juice, 15ml lime juice and 5ml grenadine. Stir and finish with a light grating of nutmeg. Totals are 180ml rum, 120ml each pineapple and orange juice, 60ml lime juice and 20ml grenadine.

shopping: 4 small poppy seed hot dog buns@Bakery
